result.Method of Attack: Drops a second-stage payload by decoding an embedded base64 string, writing it to disk, and executing it; backdoors the system and exfiltrates system information, private SSH keys, environment variables, and contents of select folders (e.g., ~/.aws) to file sharing services (file.io and Dropbox)
Impacted Systems: Systems of security researchers, pentesters, offensive actors
Attack Vector: Trojanized npm package included in malicious GitHub repositories
Phishing campaign delivering the same second-stage payload
Trojanized GitHub repositories embedding the malicious npm package
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious GitHub repositories such as hpc20235/yawpp
Hardcoded Dropbox access token and file.io token in the payload
Malicious commits with committer name 'robert' and ProtonMail address
Phishing email subject: 'Notification: Important CPU Microcode Update for High-Performance Computing (HPC) Users Inbox'
Phishing email senders: root@opencompiled.org, cicd@opencompiled.org, opencompiled@memeware.net
